name: Prestige Catamaran
summary: Prestige Catamaran sails a 75 foot Fountaine Pajot Tahiti 75S catamaran and has run tours in Martinique, St. Lucia and Barbados. Its website lists a Bridgetown contact address but shows no Barbados tours at present.
standouts: Tahiti 75S catamaran, 75 feet long, built by Fountaine Pajot
checkNotes: Looks closed: the Barbados tours page (last modified 24 Dec 2021) lists no tours; the shop says No products were found; the events calendar shows nothing for October 2026 and its most recent past event is 11 Sep 2022 (earlier events are Martinique and St. Lucia trips from Dec 2018); the Events page says no special event is scheduled; the newest page change anywhere is the menus page on 20 Nov 2023 and no image upload on the pages read is newer than April 2021; the site's SSL certificate expired on 11 Jul 2025 (pages were read over HTTPS without certificate checking). The footer copyright reads 2026, which is likely automatic. Still on the site: a Rentals page with a Basic 4 Hour charter package (captain and deckhands, premium sound system, fully stocked bar, lunch menu by Chef Creig, no price, island not stated) taken by inquiry form, and a contact page giving Shallow Draught, Bridgetown, Barbados, phone and WhatsApp +1 246-832-1786, and email info@www.prestigecatamaran.com, which looks malformed (the cancellation policy uses reservations@prestigecatamaran.com). The batch lists the alias Barbados Prestige Tours with email info@barbadosprestigetours.com and an address at Newton Plantation, Christ Church; that domain may be the current Barbados business but it is not the given website and was not opened.
